Card Q&A.q: When my Digimon with the [Insectoid] trait and this card in its digivolution cards is suspended, can this card's inherited effect switch the target of an opponent's Digimon's attack to that Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your suspended Digimon with the [Insectoid] trait.
